en.answer: The effect of <<7734>> cannot be activated in response to the activation of <<4999>>'s effect, even if the Summoned monster's ATK is 2000 or less.
en.question: A monster with 2000 or less ATK is Summoned in Attack Position, and the effect of <<4999>> is activated. Can I now activate the effect of <<7734>> in response?
en.title: If the effect of <<4999>> is activated, can I activate the effect of <<7734>> in response?

ja.answer: 攻撃力2000以下のモンスターを攻撃表示で召喚・特殊召喚した際に発動した「<<4999>>」の効果にチェーンをして、「<<7734>>」の効果を発動する事はできません。
